turns.text: When we look ahead in future years, we might look back at how much of an impact Facebook had on our brains, we might say, 'yeah it did change me completely and I would have been a different human if it weren't for social media,' we don't know.
turns.zh: 当我们展望未来几年，我们可能会回顾 Facebook 对我们大脑产生了多大的影响，我们可能会说，‘是的，它确实彻底改变了我，如果不是社交媒体，我会是一个不同的人’，我们不知道。

turns.text: Yeah, it's gonna have an impact.
